description: Reply to a specific message in a DM, attaching a quoted reply reference. Unlike the edit/delete DM tools, this works on any message in the conversation (the bot's or the user's). Use discord_send_dm for a standalone DM with no reference. Returns the new reply's message ID.

content.description: Plain-text body of the reply (max 2000 characters).

message_id.description: ID of the target message within the DM conversation.

user_id.description: Discord user ID (snowflake) of the DM recipient.

name: discord_reply_dm
